verdict.rationale: Warp's automation platform documents Triggers that react to Slack, Linear, GitHub, or custom webhook events, plus Schedules for recurring tasks. Cloud agents run autonomously in the background when fired by system events, schedules, or integrations, and each run gets an auditable transcript. Missing for 10: detail on how trigger rules and conditions are defined or configured (syntax, filters, action mapping), and independent or hands-on corroboration that event-triggered automation works as claimed.
